headline: Chinese Banks Expand e-CNY Digital Currency to Offshore Institutions
summary: China is extending its central bank digital currency network to offshore institutions, including Hong Kong branches, while exploring local e-CNY wallets for foreign enterprises.
why: Broadening the reach of a central bank digital currency (CBDC) facilitates cross-border settlements and deepens international integration of the yuan financial architecture.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: The expansion of the e-CNY framework impacts cross-border monetary infrastructure.
